title: AIR CONDITIONING- TEST PROCEDURE
summary: Air conditioning (RPO C60) evacuating and charging equipment hookup, shown as an example only: lines from the two Schrader service fittings on the compressor fitting & muffler assembly join at a tee, then run to a valve from the refrigerant supply and a valve to the vacuum supply. Companion to the procedure on E8. No part numbers.
notes: 'SCHRADER' FITTING (2) on COMPRESSOR FITTING & MUFFLER ASM; lines tee together to a VALVE FROM REFRIGERANT SUPPLY and a VALVE TO VACUUM SUPPLY.
notes_internal: Shop equipment illustration only; no callouts, part numbers or torques. Torque triangles 1-5 printed at lower left with no values.
Title block: drawing 3965172; DR C1, CK 5-8-69 C1, PREL 5-5-69, C/O E7. No revisions.
